name: needletooth_pack_no_counters_without_a_death_or_on_opponents_turn
notes: M6 mapper. Printed: 'Morbid — At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, put two +1/+1 counters on target creature you control.' Seat 0's turn ends with no creature dead: no trigger. On seat 1's turn seat 1's Bear dies, but seat 1's end step is not seat 0's: no trigger either (it would ask for a target this pack does not give). Nobody gets a counter.
